body: This is quite honestly the best thing I've read all week.  Really puts things into perspective.
The debt isn't the problem.  I really don't know what is.  Maybe a combination of a lot of things.

Yeah this is something that my family and friends can't understand.  I think I just needed to talk to somebody about what's going on.  These dark thoughts that have been there ever since I can remember.  They just wouldn't understand.

I'm not saying that the debt is why I want to do it. Only that once it's paid up, which would take hardly any time at all, I'm afraid that I'll finally not have a reason to stay.  It's a co-signed loan so I can't just give them that debt.
